I would judge a pilot by workers’ take-home pay, recorded hours, the workload of the people on duty, access to services, and what happens to output and jobs. A free weekday and earlier evenings solve different problems, so workers should have a say in the choice.

I see the appeal of a full extra day off, but four days on the schedule doesn’t necessarily mean fewer hours. If the same work spills into unpaid evenings or weekends, that extra day isn’t really yours.
